parent.notes: Adds an SOS notification and Children tab ordering. The app reads the SOS alerts recorded on the server, so an SOS is not missed when a normal location report arrives right after it, and shows one urgent notification per SOS, also when the app is closed and background alerts are on. On the Children tab the child who pressed SOS last is shown first and the one before second. Includes the pre-filled server address from v1.4.16. Login, billing and all other features are unchanged. Signed ARM + ARM64 APK after successful static analysis and tests. No phone testing claimed.

client.notes: Adds 32-bit ARM support. Previous APKs lacked the 32-bit Flutter engine and app library; this may explain launch failure on 32-bit Android. All features are unchanged from v24 (source diff: build and version files only). Retest pending on a 32-bit phone. Signed ARM + ARM64 + x86-64 APK after successful static analysis and tests. Not tested on a physical phone.

tiffe_staff.notes:
Tiffe Staff 1.0.10: light mode, Updates button, clearer kitchen cards, accept step and Remove bhaji.
Light mode: the sun/moon button in the hub header switches between light and dark, and the choice is remembered. Every screen repaints when you switch, including the kitchen totals, which were white-on-white in light mode before. Dark mode is still available.
Updates: a labelled Updates button sits next to Sync in the kitchen summary. It says Checking… while it looks, then shows either "You have the latest version" or the in-app update window (download inside the app, then the Android installer). Sync and Updates text is now bright in both themes.
Ready for Pickup: a disabled Confirm Handover button now has readable text. The hint under it no longer sends you to All Orders for rider assignment; it says to assign the delivery partner on the same card, and only points to All Orders when payment still needs verifying.
New orders: once the owner runs the one-time database update (tiffe-v56 SQL), new orders arrive as "Order placed" and the customer sees "Confirmed" only after you tap Accept Order. Then tap Start Preparing. Existing orders are unchanged and show Start Preparing straight away.
Menu: each bhaji has a Remove button, separate from the availability switch, with a confirmation. A removed bhaji leaves every menu but stays in old orders' history. Needs the same database update.
Not tested on a phone. Analyze, the full test suite and the signed build passed in CI before publishing.

tiffe.notes: Order updates: the notification prompt shows again on phones where an old setting had hidden it; if you say no, Tiffe respects that and Profile > Notifications opens Android settings to turn them on. While the app is closed Tiffe checks your orders about every 15 minutes, plus once about 5 minutes after you leave the app (not instant push). New orders read Order placed until the kitchen accepts them, then Confirmed (once the kitchen database update is applied; existing orders are unchanged). Bhajis the kitchen removes no longer appear on the menu. Not phone-tested.
